reason: The current model achieves macro validation HR@10=0.5175, below the recorded best of 0.5388, with Electronics weakest at 0.395. Successful recurrent-memory experiments support retaining the GRU and ranking setup, while failed candidate-independent attention experiments motivate testing candidate-conditioned retrieval specifically; the results do not establish the cause of the gap. Modify model_design for the shared candidate-conditioned scorer and training_evaluation for efficient training and exact predictor parity, leaving data processing unchanged.

plan.model_design: Replace RecurrentMemory's candidate-independent attention readout and dot-product scoring with candidate-conditioned attention over GRU contextual history states, retaining the embeddings, input normalization, GRU backbone, hidden size 96, MAXLEN=64, and dropout 0.25. Preserve the RecurrentMemory constructor and encode(seq), forward(seq, positives, negatives), and predict(seq, candidates) signatures; make encode return contextual states h and add one shared scoring helper used by both forward and predict, preserving pos_scores and neg_scores shapes expected by train_category. Reuse query_projection for candidate embeddings and key_projection/value_projection for contextual states, computing scaled attention over nonpadding history positions j<=t for each supervised position t, including the current observed item but excluding its future target; safely zero fully masked attention rows to avoid NaNs. Feed retrieved context, the recurrent state at t, and the candidate embedding into a small shared hidden-width MLP producing one final logit, retaining item_bias as a jointly learned parameter and replacing the previous readout rather than adding its score. Each candidate must be scored independently of other presented candidates, with all projections and the scorer trained jointly within exactly one network per category; unlike the unsuccessful recurrent-query attention experiment, retrieval queries now depend explicitly on the item being scored.
plan.training_evaluation: Route training positives, training negatives, validation candidates, and deployed candidates through the identical scoring helper, vectorizing attention and chunking candidate or supervised-position dimensions to bound single-GPU memory without detaching gradients or changing loss normalization. Preserve the current 32-negative sampler, allowed and valid_positions masks, masked sampled-softmax ranking objective, 0.2-weighted positive/negative BCE, 0.9 temporal weighting, random-prefix sampling, AdamW settings, cosine schedule, gradient clipping, batch size, steps, 30-epoch patience, deadlines, and environment-controlled SASREC_EPOCHS default of 200 so the experiment isolates the architectural change. Update write_predictor to export the complete modified RecurrentMemory class through inspect.getsource with required imports, preserve checkpoint config/state_dict keys and train_category, evaluate, fixed_validation, write_predictor, and predict signatures, and strictly load exactly one newly trained checkpoint for each of the four existing dataset routes.
